findings.text: follow-on: the base arm's log names the head worktree's reckon/_plan_html.py as its module under test, so the base arm ran the base tree (its new corpus-sweep tests fail and its round trip matches mine) but its own header cannot show which module it imported.
follow-on: test_logs names logs/base_read_counts.log, which is absent from the run directory, so the base read count (92 of 111) the done_when asks to record is in no log the manifest names.

follow-on: the cited log ships a second round-trip figure, 37 plans byte-nonidentical, against the manifest's 141 of 143; it measures a raw write_state rather than the store's write and is identical at base and head, but the manifest never reconciles the two figures.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 84fd7ff4f; 5656e5326 widens the reader and filters the writer at reckon/_plan_html.py:1049, 20ce5e127 adds the evidence fragment; no behaviour outside the comments collection changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_section_body_records_are_read.py, the base/head read counts, the declared negative control and a corpus round trip; each is recorded, and I independently reproduced the read counts, the negative-control failure set and the round trip (141 of 143 byte-identical, the same two plans either side).
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is to make read_state return a section-body r-comment record under the section its own data-section names; reckon/_plan_html.py:723 now selects every .r-comment outside pre/code and keys it by data-section, and my own base-vs-head run reads 92 then 111 of 111 records on docs/plans/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion.html, both §2d landing records now present.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states the gate result, the negative control and the round trip, but its test_logs names logs/base_read_counts.log, which is absent from the run directory, so the base-arm read count lives only in the manifest prose.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest fences reckon/_plan_html.py, tests/test_section_body_records_are_read.py and the evidence fragment; the diff touches exactly those three paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: re-restricting read_state to the comments section in a scratch copy reddens test_both_records_are_read_under_the_section_that_holds_them and two others that pass at head (logs/negative_control.log), and test_a_write_leaves_a_section_body_record_where_it_is asserts file bytes outside the edited region.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_section_body_records_are_read.py passes 6 of 6 at head and its declared mutation reddens three cases, but the manifest cites logs/base_gate.log whose header names the head module and a logs/base_read_counts.log that does not exist.
justifications.fit: the helpers at reckon/_plan_html.py:415 carry the module's existing BeautifulSoup idiom and no plan label, and ruff reports the same 13 findings with identical rule codes at base and head.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_plan_html.py:723 returns every .r-comment outside pre/code under its own data-section, and my base-vs-head run reads 92 then 111 on docs/plans/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion.html with both §2d records present.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 84fd7ff4f..20ce5e127 touches only reckon/_plan_html.py, tests/test_section_body_records_are_read.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
